use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};
use std::panic::{catch_unwind, AssertUnwindSafe};
trait Value { fn value(&self) -> u32; }
struct Probe(u8, Arc<Mutex<Vec<u8>>>);
impl Drop for Probe { fn drop(&mut self) { self.1.lock().unwrap().push(self.0); } }
#[repr(align(64))]
struct Tail(Probe);
impl Value for Tail { fn value(&self) -> u32 { 7 } }
struct Header<T: ?Sized> { panic: bool, prefix: Probe, tail: T }
impl<T: ?Sized> Drop for Header<T> {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        self.prefix.1.lock().unwrap().push(0);
        if self.panic { panic!("header drop"); }
    }
}
fn main() {
    std::panic::set_hook(Box::new(|_| {}));
    for destructor_panics in [false, true] {
        let log = Arc::new(Mutex::new(Vec::new()));
        let result = catch_unwind(AssertUnwindSafe(|| {
            let value: Box<Header<dyn Value>> = Box::new(Header { panic: destructor_panics, prefix: Probe(1, log.clone()), tail: Tail(Probe(2, log.clone())) });
            assert_eq!(value.tail.value(), 7);
            if destructor_panics { drop(value); } else { panic!("outer unwind"); }
        }));
        assert!(result.is_err());
        assert_eq!(*log.lock().unwrap(), vec![0,1,2]);
        println!("{:?}", *log.lock().unwrap());
    }
}
